name: text_report
description: Text statistics: characters, letters, words, sentences and paragraphs, the most frequent words with optional English or Spanish stopword removal, top 2- and 3-grams, reading and speaking time at stated words per minute, the longest sentences, and lexical diversity (type-token ratio, optional MTLD). Tokenizer rules are stated in the output.

input.text:
The cat sat on the mat. The dog didn't sit! Did the bird fly away?

Yes, it flew.

catalog.source: original; reading speed default from Brysbaert (2019), 'How many words do we read per minute?', J. Memory and Language 109; MTLD from McCarthy and Jarvis (2010), Behavior Research Methods 42(2)
